name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Fix overlapping page tabs, clipped library navigation, native thick TV borders and grey poster corners. Keep header fixed with limited blur; separate Media Bar controls and prevent clipped action focus. Automatic slideshow fix requires Media Bar 3.0.0.3.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
